name: ntfy
description: Send push notifications to phones and desktops through an ntfy server
summary: ntfy REST calls from a workflow. Built from the LeForge usertasks-connectors repository.
setup_notes: Packaged for one ntfy server (npm run package -- ntfy --url <server URL>). Set the secret "api_token" on the Access tab (optional for this server type): Optional. Leave empty for a server that allows anonymous publish. Create it on the server with: ntfy token add <user>. A topic for each alert stream An access token with write access to those topics (ntfy token add)
author: LeForge

inputs.label: Priority
inputs.description: 1 (min) to 5 (max), or min, low, default, high, urgent

inputs.name: tags
inputs.label: Tags
inputs.description: Comma-separated tags; emoji short codes such as warning or white_check_mark show as emoji

inputs.name: click
inputs.label: Click
inputs.description: URL to open when the notification is tapped

inputs.name: markdown
inputs.label: Markdown
inputs.description: yes to render the message as Markdown
